kpis.totalContractValueExplanation: Sum of all active contract values over their committed duration. For contracts without an end date, uses the minimum duration.
kpis.annualRecurringRevenueExplanation: Annual Recurring Revenue: Monthly value of all recurring items from active contracts, multiplied by 12. Excludes one-off items.
kpis.yearToDateRevenueExplanation: Revenue recognized from January 1st of the current year to today.
kpis.currentYearForecastExplanation: Projected total revenue for the current calendar year (January 1 - December 31).
kpis.nextYearForecastExplanation: Projected total revenue for the next calendar year. Excludes contracts ending before next year.
kpis.newNameArrExplanation: Annualized recurring revenue from new customers (no prior-year contracts). Bookings, not invoiced revenue.
kpis.backToBaseArrExplanation: ARR from won deals of existing customers plus expansion/upsell items on existing contracts. Bookings, not invoiced revenue.
kpis.wonDevelopmentExplanation: Development and training bookings from won deals this year.
kpis.wonDealCountExplanation: Number of HubSpot deals won this year.

revenueGoals.title: Revenue Goals
revenueGoals.recurringExplanation: Full-year forecast for recurring revenue, calculated from the recognition schedule of all active contracts. Unlike ARR (which is today's monthly run rate x 12), this accounts for contracts starting or ending mid-year, price changes, and prorations.
revenueGoals.streamExplanation: Full-year forecast for this revenue stream, calculated from the recognition schedule of all active contracts classified under this stream.

priceIncrease.title: Price Increase Impact
priceIncrease.totalImpactExplanation: Additional ARR from price increases compared to the previous year
priceIncrease.inflationExplanation: ARR impact from standard annual inflation adjustments
priceIncrease.negotiatedExplanation: ARR impact from individually negotiated price changes
priceIncrease.untaggedExplanation: ARR impact from price increases without a tagged increase type
